description: PA hired 1,350 people with federal experience by 2026-08 under an equivalency order; NY hired 28 in the first month of its campaign. No source breaks out environmental hires, and targeted roles skew to HR, IT, health and engineering.

role_title: State HR classification analyst using generative AI to crosswalk titles
description: PA HR staff used generative AI to match state qualifications to federal titles; MI runs an AI job-matching portal.

role_title: Entry-level environmental professional without a degree
description: Colorado reports 25% of 2024 hires in skills-emphasizing classes had no degree (1,588); MN MPCA supervisory classes are experience-only; FL ES II accepts 4 years' experience. CA, MI and TPWD classes still require degrees, so entry paths diverge by state.

role_title: Sub-licensure technical roles (Engineering Specialist, Geologic Specialist, Environmental Specialist)
description: Licensure statutes split classes into licensed and sub-licensure tracks (TX Engineering Specialist cannot perform PE duties; Geologic Specialist works under a licensed P.G.; WI renamed engineering-specialist classes under 2017 Act 111).

role_title: State DOT environmental scientist under dual CEQA/NEPA regime
description: Caltrans environmental scientists prepare both CEQA and NEPA documents subject to FHWA review, merging state and federal environmental review in one role.

role_title: Municipal environmental services specialist (science plus policy)
description: San Jose's class bundles environmental program management with contract, legislative advocacy and policy work, which v1 splits across domains 3, 5 and 6.
